3.speaker: Narrator
3.text: When we entered the room, Petr was speaking to the cabinet members who were already seated around the table. As soon as they noticed me, they all stood up.

6.speaker: Narrator
6.text: Petr turned towards me. Everybody except him took their seats. He stood right next to my chair in the middle.

7.speaker: Player
7.text: "Good day everybody. Please have a seat."

9.speaker: Player_Italic
9.text: Say nothing and watch the room.

10.speaker: Narrator
10.text: Petr stood right next to my seat in the middle. He turned to me and gave a wave of his hand.

12.speaker: Narrator
12.text: He held out my chair for me to sit down and smiled.

14.speaker: Narrator
14.text: He held out my chair for me to sit down and smiled.

16.speaker: Narrator
16.text: When I sat down, everybody immediately took their seats.

18.speaker: Petr Vectern
18.text: "Ladies and gentlemen, we are here to discuss our current status and plan the remaining of our term."

19.speaker: Petr Vectern
19.text: "I know that some of you have had your concerns about our style of governance so far. There will be a time to speak up about these in the meeting today."

20.speaker: Petr Vectern
20.text: "But I must also thank you all for your hard work so far. We are very lucky to have a team like this. All of you have been invaluable to this administration."

30.speaker: Petr Vectern
30.text: "We have worked long and hard but we couldn't reform the Sordish Constitution..."
30.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Reform_Court_Success"] == true) == false) and (Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Reformist_Path"] == true  or  Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Dictator_Path"] == true)

53.speaker: Petr Vectern
53.text: "Having said that... Now we have reached a critical point of our term. We are nearing the end."
53.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["BaseGame.Relations_Nia_Opposition"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["BaseGame.Turn04_PSnW_Education_Progressive"] == false  or  Variable["BaseGame.Relations_Nia_Opposition"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["BaseGame.Faction_Oligarchs_Ally"] == true  or  Variable["BaseGame.Malenyevist"] >= 6  or  Variable["BaseGame.Turn03_EnT_LawEnforcement_Budget_Decrease"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["BaseGame.Faction_Oligarchs_Enemy"] == true  or  Variable["BaseGame.Faction_Oligarchs_Destroyed"] == true) == false)

54.speaker: Petr Vectern
54.text: "We have successfully made changes to the Sordish Constitution. This is a historic accomplishment. Without this team, it couldn't have been possible."
54.conditionsRaw: (Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Reform_Court_Success"] == true) and (Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Reformist_Path"] == true  or  Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Dictator_Path"] == true)

55.speaker: Petr Vectern
55.text: "Sadly and for reasons outside of our control, Sordland plunged into violent terror at the beginning of our term. It became our duty to save Sordland. We all knew it was an emergency."
55.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Reformist_Path"] == true  or  Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Dictator_Path"] == true) == false) and (Variable["BaseGame.Decision_Turn05_AutocratEmergency_Extend"] == true) and (Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Autocrat_CourtVote_Success"] == true)

56.speaker: Petr Vectern
56.text: "Today, the state of emergency still continues. Despite making some of our jobs harder, it has also helped stabilize our nation."

59.speaker: Petr Vectern
59.text: "We'll be discussing our current status and planning the remainder of our term."

60.speaker: Narrator

61.speaker: Petr Vectern
61.text: "Now that Mr. President is here, we can begin the meeting. I know that some of you have had your concerns about our style of governance so far. There will be a time to speak up about these in the meeting today."

62.speaker: Petr Vectern
62.text: "Sadly and for reasons outside of our control, Sordland had plunged into violent terror in the beginning of our term. It became our duty to save Sordland. We all knew it was an emergency."
62.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Reformist_Path"] == true  or  Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Dictator_Path"] == true) == false) and (Variable["BaseGame.Decision_Turn05_AutocratEmergency_Extend"] == true) and ((Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Autocrat_CourtVote_Success"] == true) == false)

63.speaker: Petr Vectern
63.text: "As we all know, the state of emergency is no longer in place. In a plot against President Rayne, it was revoked prematurely by the Supreme Court."

64.speaker: Petr Vectern
64.text: "Do not make a mistake. This plot affects all of us. An attack against President Rayne is an attack against our whole administration."

65.speaker: Petr Vectern
65.text: "It is against the United Sordland Party. And ultimately, against the people of Sordland."

66.speaker: Petr Vectern
66.text: "As we all know, the beginning of our term saw an extraordinary period of violence that led us to a state of emergency."
66.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Reformist_Path"] == true  or  Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Dictator_Path"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["BaseGame.Decision_Turn05_AutocratEmergency_Extend"] == true) == false) and (Variable["BaseGame.Faction_OldGuard_Content"] == true)

67.speaker: Petr Vectern
67.text: "Mr. President was brave enough to act swiftly, and thus we have successfully restored stability in a time of uncertainty."

68.speaker: Petr Vectern
68.text: "As we all know, the state of emergency that was declared against the chaos in the beginning of our term, is no longer in place."
68.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Reformist_Path"] == true  or  Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Dictator_Path"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["BaseGame.Decision_Turn05_AutocratEmergency_Extend"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["BaseGame.Faction_OldGuard_Content"] == true) == false)

69.speaker: Petr Vectern
69.text: "Mr. President was brave enough to act swiftly and revoked his decree when the situation was stabilized. However, the same Justices who agreed to the decree are now trying to use it against him."

70.speaker: Petr Vectern
70.text: "Do not make a mistake. This is a clear plot that affects all of us. An attack against President Rayne is an attack against our whole administration."

75.speaker: Petr Vectern
75.text: "Even though some people, even within our own administration, had hoped to see us fail in the Court... We did succeed."

82.text: "The Supreme Court blocked us once again. Unfortunately, some people within our team also worked towards this goal."

83.speaker: Narrator

90.text: "The new Constitution has brought us one step closer to the Sordish dream. We should be proud for having strengthened our democracy."

140.speaker: Petr Vectern

236.conditionsRaw: (Variable["BaseGame.Economy"] >= 3  and  Variable["BaseGame.GovernmentBudget"] >= -2) and ((Variable["BaseGame.Economy"] >= 5  and  Variable["BaseGame.GovernmentBudget"] >= -4) == false) and ((Variable["BaseGame.Economy"] >= 7  and  Variable["BaseGame.GovernmentBudget"] >= -6) == false)

237.speaker: Petr Vectern
237.text: "This will have dire consequences for our administration."

238.speaker: Petr Vectern
238.text: "A major concern of the people is the state of our economy. We are slowly slipping into a depression."
238.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["BaseGame.Economy"] >= 3  and  Variable["BaseGame.GovernmentBudget"] >= -2) == false) and ((Variable["BaseGame.Economy"] >= 5  and  Variable["BaseGame.GovernmentBudget"] >= -4) == false) and ((Variable["BaseGame.Economy"] >= 7  and  Variable["BaseGame.GovernmentBudget"] >= -6) == false)

239.speaker: Petr Vectern
239.text: "If everything goes well, it is a matter of time that people will feel its results. Our economy is not looking too bad."

240.speaker: Petr Vectern
240.text: "I must thank Mr. Holl for his great work."

241.speaker: Petr Vectern
241.text: "This is the time to give the best we can. For this administration and for Sordland."

242.speaker: Narrator
242.text: Symon nodded with a dimpled smile.

243.speaker: Petr Vectern
243.text: "We mustn't lose hope and give it our best. Sordland needs us more than ever."

245.speaker: Petr Vectern
245.text: "I'll give the word to the President now."

246.speaker: Petr Vectern
246.text: "If everything goes well, it is a matter of time that people will feel its results. Our economy is looking good."

247.speaker: Petr Vectern
247.text: "Our success with these changes has brought with it great support. Our party --which was divided at the beginning of our term-- is finally coming together once more."

266.speaker: Petr Vectern
266.text: "Gloria and the conservative wing of the party didn't back us up."

267.speaker: Petr Vectern
267.text: "Some party centrists have opposed us due to our decision to veto the campaign finance bill."
267.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Gloria_Convinced"] == false) == false) and (Variable["BaseGame.Prologue_Family_Important"] == true  and  Variable["BaseGame.Bill_Turn01_CampaignFinance_Signed"] == false)

268.speaker: Petr Vectern
268.text: "Albin and the reformist wing didn't vote for us."
268.conditionsRaw: (Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Albin_Convinced"] == false) and ((Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Gloria_Convinced"] == false) == false) and ((Variable["BaseGame.Prologue_Family_Important"] == true  and  Variable["BaseGame.Bill_Turn01_CampaignFinance_Signed"] == false) == false)

269.speaker: Petr Vectern
269.text: "Frens Ricter and the PFJP left us hanging on the assembly floor. They voted nay."
269.conditionsRaw: (Variable["BaseGame.Reform_VoteCount_PFJP_RictersWing"] <= 2) and ((Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Albin_Convinced"] == false) == false) and ((Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Gloria_Convinced"] == false) == false) and ((Variable["BaseGame.Prologue_Family_Important"] == true  and  Variable["BaseGame.Bill_Turn01_CampaignFinance_Signed"] == false) == false)

270.speaker: Petr Vectern
270.text: "Kesaro Kibener and the National Front MP's didn't like the proposal and voted against it."
270.conditionsRaw: (Variable["BaseGame.Reform_VoteCount_NFP"] <= 1) and ((Variable["BaseGame.Reform_VoteCount_PFJP_RictersWing"] <= 2) == false) and ((Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Albin_Convinced"] == false) == false) and ((Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Gloria_Convinced"] == false) == false) and ((Variable["BaseGame.Prologue_Family_Important"] == true  and  Variable["BaseGame.Bill_Turn01_CampaignFinance_Signed"] == false) == false)

271.speaker: Petr Vectern
271.text: "The Lotherberg group led a massive lobbying effort against us in the Assembly which caused us to lose many votes."
271.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["BaseGame.Reform_VoteCount_NFP"] <= 1) == false) and ((Variable["BaseGame.Reform_VoteCount_PFJP_RictersWing"] <= 2) == false) and ((Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Albin_Convinced"] == false) == false) and (Variable["BaseGame.Faction_Oligarchs_Enemy"] == true) and ((Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Gloria_Convinced"] == false) == false) and ((Variable["BaseGame.Prologue_Family_Important"] == true  and  Variable["BaseGame.Bill_Turn01_CampaignFinance_Signed"] == false) == false)

272.speaker: Petr Vectern
272.text: "Lucian and I have begun investigating who let us down at the vote when we needed them the most."

280.speaker: Petr Vectern
280.text: "Isabel and the other justices lenient to her legal opinion did not support us."

281.speaker: Petr Vectern
281.text: "Heron and the other centrists voted against us."

285.speaker: Petr Vectern
285.text: "We lost most of our support after editing the proposal to include changes to Articles 6 and 7."

289.speaker: Petr Vectern
289.text: "Despite doing our best, we didn't get enough support from the Assembly."

290.speaker: Petr Vectern
290.text: "The higher-ups of the USP has abandoned their support for our administration."
